about.title: Laguna Hills Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Laguna Hills sees a steady stream of collisions along its busiest corridors — I-5, Alicia Parkway, Paseo De Valencia, and Moulton Parkway — with public records showing 140 injury collisions and 208 people injured in the most recent full year. Crashes tend to cluster on Wednesday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m., often tied to school pickup, commuter traffic, and shopping-center congestion near the Laguna Hills Mall area. Whether you were rear-ended on Moulton Parkway or sideswiped merging onto I-5, the aftermath can mean medical bills, missed work, and confusing calls from insurance adjusters. LawProactive doesn't practice law — we simply connect injured Laguna Hills residents with an independent attorney who can evaluate the crash, handle communication with insurers, and explain your options under California law. There's no cost to get connected, and no obligation to move forward. Our goal is to make that first step easier during a stressful time.

whyChoose.title: Why Laguna Hills Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Time Limits Move Faster Than You Think
items.desc: California generally allows two years from the crash date to file a lawsuit, but claims against a government entity — like a city-owned intersection near Alicia Parkway — can require notice in as little as six months. Getting connected early helps preserve your options.

items.title: Your Recorded Words Can Be Used Against You
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning even a partial share of blame can reduce, but doesn't erase, your ability to recover. An attorney can advise you before you give the other driver's insurer a recorded statement that might be used to shift blame your way.

items.title: No Cap on What You've Actually Lost
items.desc: California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering in a typical car accident case, and attorneys in our network work on contingency — meaning there's no fee unless you recover.

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, which means they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward after you're connected.

items.question: I was in a crash near the I-5 and Alicia Parkway interchange — does it matter where it happened?
items.answer: Location can matter for figuring out who may be responsible, especially if a public roadway or traffic signal was involved. An independent attorney can review the specific corridor and circumstances of your Laguna Hills crash to help sort out the details.

items.question: Should I talk to the other driver's insurance company first?
items.answer: It's generally wise to be cautious before giving a recorded statement to the other side's insurer, since anything you say could be used to argue you share more fault under California's comparative fault rule. Speaking with an attorney first, even briefly, can help you avoid saying something that gets used against you later.
